mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate improving consumer confidence and construction activity, which supports economic growth and positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST increases by at least 1% month-over-month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.5 percentage points in the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline in the past month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals an impending recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) below 320.0 in the past month signals deflationary pressures, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 320.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a severe labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises in the past month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth rate > 1.0% annualized), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a potential slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST declines in a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 1.0% annualized), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
